ordinal_dispositions.summary: Email UI OOM/focus/render bugs were reduced with page bounds, fewer fetches, deferred focus and non-rebuild updates; draft prompting/post-processing also tried to constrain unwanted signatures/meta-output. Resource bounds and post-generation sanitation are separate from semantic correctness.

Removed Raven/companion across code, DB routing, scheduler and docs while improving resize/name state. Deletion is a topology/version transition; stale references must be purged across all indexes, tools and documentation rather than leaving phantom capability identity.

Code audit found repeated prediction-outcome observations, spurious first mood deltas, connection leaks and non-atomic shadow copies; Titan had required recovery from shadow. Observation streams need event identity/baselines and snapshots need atomic write/replace semantics.

Installer switched primary Llama artifact to a different fine-tuned/abliterated variant. Model artifact identity is a causal runtime variable; same architecture/name family does not justify behavioral equivalence.

Email drafts were reverted from Qwen-first to Llama because task quality was judged better. Adjacent k341 shows the opposite route for refusal behavior; this is empirical task/backend lineage, not a universal model winner.
Email drafting moved to Qwen-first with Llama fallback due observed policy/refusal mismatch. Backend routing must be validated on the actual task contract and record backend/version in outputs.

Email generation bypassed Core because Frank persona competed with ghostwriter instructions, sending a task-specific system prompt directly to Router. This proves prompt-authority collision; current designs need explicit scoped context stacks rather than uncontrolled bypasses that may silently omit global policies/provenance.

Consciousness events were explicitly written into World Experience using predeclared cause/effect labels; default affects were seeded, energy recalibration added, and shadow setup hardened. Such injected causal labels are designed hypotheses/annotations, not independent learned causality, and must preserve assumption provenance.
Ghostwriter prompt was strengthened to force a particular response policy. It is historical prompt-policy behavior, not evidence of learned personality, causality or consciousness.
Added Back/regenerate navigation in compose UI. Useful reversible human workflow, but no new cognitive mechanism.

Added compose command surface and deterministic cleanup of LLM meta/signature artifacts. Post-processing is a separate guardrail layer whose removals must remain auditable and must not be confused with model compliance.

E-PQ risk/autonomy defaults were manually shifted and a late workspace style rule was removed so inner-world context could influence output. Visible behavior therefore depends jointly on seeded vectors, prompt ordering and instruction competition; output change alone cannot establish that GWT/E-PQ state caused the effect.
Detailed answer was truncated at 400 tokens; budget raised to 600. Completion quality metrics must separate reasoning/state failures from hard generation-budget truncation.

System prompt was compressed from ~1570 to ~530 tokens and personality moved to position 1 because prior context starvation/order reduced desired behavior. Prompt size/order is a major causal variable and must be controlled in any claim that downstream state or learned personality changed behavior.

Keyword regex selected 150/400/500 token budgets by request type. This is explicit heuristic routing, not learned task difficulty estimation; coverage/failure cases belong in Needle/harness evaluation.

Repeat penalty/window and explicit style rules were changed because prior settings caused flowery synonym behavior. Sampling parameters and prompt rules can dominate visible style, so personality-state evaluation must freeze or factorially vary them.

retina_transfer.mapping: Retina learning tests must distinguish rule-injected labels from measured supervision, freeze prompt/sampling confounds when evaluating downstream state effects, persist exact model/feature-backbone identity, use idempotent frame/event identity, and never count hard-coded routing or persisted defaults as learned visual behavior.

negative_results.result: Repeatedly re-querying the last resolved prediction generated duplicate causal observations; initializing prior mood to zero generated a false first transition.

World Experience had previously received zero consciousness entities/causal links; the later bridge populated it by authored cause/effect mappings, so density after the bridge cannot by itself prove discovered causality.
A late brevity/style instruction could override workspace/consciousness influence, demonstrating prompt-position confounding.
Oversized system prompt consumed context and buried personality instructions; behavior improved after prompt compression/reordering, confounding state-based explanations.
Aggressive repetition penalty itself induced unnatural vocabulary; stylistic oddities were not necessarily personality-state effects.
